slides.title: Project Overview
slides.subtitle: Deniz Construction Limited, Ishanyu-Bushenyi Road, Mbarara

items: Client: Deniz Construction Limited — produces and sells concrete blocks, pavers and kerbs
Problem: Super-Manager bottleneck (one person = supervisor, cashier, payroll, records, tax), unexplained cash deficits, informal labor, data vulnerability
Users: Sales Manager (primary), Business Owner (daily review), Workers (attendance)
Scope: Dual-phase system — Day: Real-time POS with receipt printing; Evening: Reconciliation with cash variance and daily report
Stakeholders: Sales Manager (primary, interviewed), Business Owner (daily visitor, not interviewed), Site Workers (no access), URA (external), Customers (upfront payment, self-transport)
Methods: Direct Observation (laptop active, receipts printed during truck loading), Semi-Structured Interview (Sales Manager: payment channels, tax, pain points)
Finding: Dual-phase reality — laptop used during day for real-time receipts AND evening for deficit reconciliation
Challenge: Gatekeeper Effect — Sales Manager withheld tax calculations, cash storage, receipt fields; Owner/Workers inaccessible
REQ-FUN-SAL-01: Post a sale to an open business date with multiple product lines; atomic commit (stock + sale + drawer); receipt prints after commit
REQ-FUN-REC-02: Log cash expenses against an open business date; deducts from expected cash
REQ-NFR-PER-01: Offline resilience — full sale + receipt printing without internet; local storage with queued sync
Artifact: Stakeholder Power/Interest table from Phase 1 field visit
Lesson: Initial end-of-day batch assumption corrected to dual-phase after observing real-time receipt printing during day
Core entities: Business_Day (Open/Closed, Opening_Cash), Sales, Sales_Items, Products, Operational_Expenses, Sale_Adjustments, Daily_Reconciliation
Atomic sales: AFTER INSERT on Sales_Items deducts Products.Current_Stock; rejects oversold lines; rolls back entire sale on failure
Adjustments: Sale_Adjustments preserves original receipt, restores stock for entry errors, records refunds via original channel
Reconciliation: CloseDay locks Business_Day row in one InnoDB transaction; validates cash count; saves snapshot + Closed status atomically
Views: Daily_Payment_Activity by date/channel; URA_Summary separates recorded VAT from adjustments; Owner-only views for Total_Profit, Tax_Liability
Conclusion: DCMS architecture driven by observed bottlenecks; every requirement maps to a database entity, trigger, or stored procedure
Next Steps: Deploy on existing office laptop with User Manual for Sales Manager; verify offline sale + receipt; verify CloseDay preserves each business date
Future Enhancements: Advanced logistics tracking, formal Secretary role logged in Future Enhancements Backlog for post-academic implementation
Q&A: 5 minutes — each member prepared to explain their contribution and one project decision
